patterns: Studio-grade claim + 3D animation clip: EHuanglu's 'AI can make 3D animation for Disney now' (1.37M views, 10K likes, 2.7K bookmarks) won with a one-line, bold benchmark against a famous studio and a polished Pixar-style clip.
3D is the meta for a second day: azed_ai's 2D-to-3D character design (Friday's top post) and EHuanglu's 3D animation both point to stylised 3D characters as the format the feed rewards.
Explorable worlds over clips: minchoi's World Labs Frameboy quote (11.1K) framed AI as moving from 'generating videos' to steerable real-time worlds.
Full stack credits: techhalla's 'They Already Saw It' (6.3K) listed the exact tool chain (Midjourney, H3, Suno, Claude) and offered prompts on request, which drives replies.
Low-engagement outsider views: the biggest outsider Seedance 2.5 'AI filmmaking' posts hit 15-19K views with only ~20 likes each, so views alone there are not a signal to copy.

drafts.draft_en:
Everyone says AI can do Disney-level 3D animation now.

So I tested it on a real VFX shot: one character, one take, real camera move, my own lighting.

Here's where it holds up and where it still breaks 👇
drafts.video_tip: 12-15s: open on a polished 3D character close-up (3s), then the same shot with a handheld camera move and practical light flicker (6s), end on a split screen 'AI raw | my comp' with one visible flaw circled in red.

drafts.draft_en:
2D sketch → 3D character → moving VFX shot.

Three steps, one afternoon, no modeling software.

The 3D-animation wave is here. This is how I'd ride it as a VFX artist 👇
drafts.video_tip: 10s triptych: 2s flat sketch, 3s 360° turnaround, 5s character walking through a live-action plate with matched shadows. Label each stage on screen.

drafts.draft_en:
AI isn't just generating clips anymore. You can walk inside the shot.

I blocked a whole VFX scene as an explorable world first, then picked my camera.

Directing > prompting.
drafts.video_tip: 8-12s: screen-record flying a camera through an AI-generated environment, freeze on the chosen frame, then cut to the final rendered shot from that exact angle.

drafts.draft_en:
Short film made with Firefly + Seedance 2.5 + Suno.

Every shot, every prompt, the full stack.

Want the prompts? Reply 'VFX' and I'll share them.
drafts.video_tip: 20-30s cinematic cut with a 1s title card listing the tool chain; keep the strongest VFX beat in the first 2 seconds so the autoplay hooks.

drafts.draft_en:
Saturday Challenge: take one 2D character and turn it into a 3D animated shot.

Any tool. Post it under this tweet.

I'll feature my favourite ones tomorrow ✨
drafts.video_tip: 6-8s example: your own 2D character morphing into a 3D version that turns its head to camera, with a 'YOUR TURN' end card.
